name: Think Any Lang
description: 思考语言选择器：可在设置中指定 DeepSeek 思考过程（思维链 CoT）使用的语言，支持 12 种语言。
descriptionEn: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a "Thinking Language" selector under Settings → General that tells the model which language to reason in (chain of thought) via a system-prompt section. Zero extra calls, zero latency, 12 languages.
author: MingLin
